title: 101-009 (Baseline)
treatment_protocol_ch1: Viable CD3+ T-cells within peripheral blood mononuclear cells were sorted using magnetic assorted cell sorting. CD3+ T-cells were then stimulated overnight using anti-CD3/anti-CD28 co-stimulation.
growth_protocol_ch1: Cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells obtained from patients enrolled in the study were thawed overnight in interleukin-2 containing culture media.
extract_protocol_ch1: After overnight stimulation cells were resuspended in PBS with 0.04% BSA and viability of the samples was determined by Trypan Blue Stain (0.4%) for use with the Countess™ II FL.

Cells were diluted or concentrated to the recommended range 500-1000 cells/μl) for loaded at a volume to recover 7000 to 10000 cells for single cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq). Single cell capture, barcoding and library preparation were performed by following the 10X Genomics Single Cell Chromium 3’ protocols (CG000315 Rev E). Ten libraries were pooled to give a final concentration of 10 nM, Pooled samples were further qPCR for final concentration before submission for sequencing with the NovaSeq6000 sequencer using the S2 100 cycles flowcell and sequence with 28 cycles for read1, 8 cycles for i7 index, and 91 cycles for read 2 through the ATGC core at MD Anderson.
